headline.en: Find code patterns that deserve a closer review.
headline.zh: 找出值得进一步检查的代码模式。

sub.en: SlopAudit scans JavaScript and TypeScript, reports heuristic findings with file and line evidence, and summarizes their weighted density as a 0–100 score.
sub.zh: SlopAudit 扫描 JavaScript 与 TypeScript，按文件和行报告启发式问题，并把加权密度汇总为 0–100 分数。

body.en: Findings identify a line and matching pattern.
body.zh: 问题指出具体行与命中模式。

body.en: Per-file scores use each file’s line count.
body.zh: 文件分数使用各自的行数。

body.en: The same score drives JSON and CI outcomes.
body.zh: JSON 与 CI 裁决使用同一分数。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Node.js 22+ and Python 3; the driver audits a temporary add.js twice and checks both expected gate statuses.
note.zh: 需要 Node.js 22+ 与 Python 3；驱动两次检查临时 add.js，并核验预期门禁状态。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Static CLI audit of a complete handwritten JS fixture before and after removing unreachable code, including the --fail-on exit status. No target code runs.

body.en: Node.js 22+ and Python 3; the driver audits a temporary add.js twice and checks both expected gate statuses.
body.zh: 需要 Node.js 22+ 与 Python 3；驱动两次检查临时 add.js，并核验预期门禁状态。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/slopaudit.git
cd slopaudit
npm ci
npm run build

limitations.en: Heuristic findings do not establish AI authorship, prove a defect or measure total technical debt. Review each finding in context.
limitations.zh: 启发式结果不证明 AI 创作、不证明缺陷，也不衡量全部技术债；每条问题都需结合上下文检查。

limitations.en: The score depends on weighted findings, scanned line counts and exclusions. A lower score alone is not evidence of improved program behavior.
limitations.zh: 分数依赖问题权重、扫描行数与排除范围；分数降低本身不证明程序行为改善。

limitations.en: Parsing can recover with warnings and some checks are local rather than whole-program analysis. The demo is a handwritten fixture, not a benchmark.
limitations.zh: 解析可能在警告后继续恢复，部分检查只分析局部而非完整程序；示例是手写 fixture，不是基准测量。

body.en: A long list of possible issues needs a starting point. File rankings and concrete evidence help a reviewer choose where to read first, while a consistent threshold can flag a change in CI.
body.zh: 可能的问题列表很长时，需要检查起点。文件排行与具体证据帮助审阅者决定先读哪里，一致的阈值也可在 CI 中提示变化。

body.en: The file walker applies source globs and exclusions. Babel parsing feeds five detector families: over-abstraction, generic boilerplate, plausible-but-wrong patterns, dead parameters and copy-paste clones. Weighted findings per line feed the score; reports and the optional threshold gate consume that same result.
body.zh: 文件遍历按源码 glob 与排除规则收集输入；Babel 解析后交给五类检测器：过度抽象、通用样板、疑似错误模式、无用参数与复制克隆。每行加权问题密度形成分数，报告和可选阈值门禁使用同一结果。

body.en: The file walker applies source globs and exclusions. Babel parsing feeds five detector families: over-abstraction, generic boilerplate, plausible-but-wrong patterns, dead parameters and copy-paste clones. Weighted findings per line feed the score; reports and the optional threshold gate consume that same result.
body.zh: 文件遍历按源码 glob 与排除规则收集输入；Babel 解析后交给五类检测器：过度抽象、通用样板、疑似错误模式、无用参数与复制克隆。每行加权问题密度形成分数，报告和可选阈值门禁使用同一结果。

body.en: Choose the input and output route that matches your workflow. The local example below exercises the stated subset.
body.zh: 根据工作流选择输入与输出路径。本文本地示例验证其中明确说明的子流程。

body.en: --fail-on accepts a score 0–100 or clean/moderate/heavy and fails at or above that threshold. Bands are clean below 34, moderate through 66 and heavy from 67. Exit 1 means the gate tripped; an empty scan or invalid threshold gives 2. --list inventories files and cannot be combined with --fail-on. Default text mode writes slopaudit-report.html and slopaudit-badge.svg in the current directory; --json does not. The Action exposes path, fail-on, version and newline-separated ignore inputs; pin the version deliberately.
body.zh: --fail-on 接受 0–100 分数或 clean/moderate/heavy，到达或超过阈值即失败。低于 34 为 clean，至 66 为 moderate，67 起为 heavy。门禁触发返回 1；空扫描或无效阈值返回 2。--list 只列文件，不能与 --fail-on 组合。默认文本模式在当前目录写 slopaudit-report.html 和 slopaudit-badge.svg，--json 不写。Action 支持 path、fail-on、version 与按行分隔的 ignore，应明确固定版本。

body.en: Run these commands from the repository root after installation. Replace paths for your own data.
body.zh: 安装后在仓库根目录运行以下命令；处理自己的数据时替换相应路径。

details.code:
node dist/cli.js ./src --json
node dist/cli.js ./src --no-html --no-badge --fail-on heavy
node dist/cli.js . --ignore "examples/**" --ignore "bench/**"
node dist/cli.js ./src --format github
